minLength.message: 19 CFR 201.14(a) periods must be at least 1 day

steps.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a): anchor at the first business day {after} {trigger} -> {date}

periods.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a) short-period rule (< 7 days): count {n} business day(s) from the anchor -> {date} (already a business day)
19 CFR 201.14(a) general rule (>= 7 days): count {n} calendar day(s) from the anchor -> {date}

forward.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or Federal legal holiday; extends until the end of the next business day -> {date}

backward.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or Federal legal holiday; extends until the end of the next business day -> {date}

steps.text: 19 CFR 201.16(d)/(e): service by {method} adds {days} calendar day(s) -> {date}
steps.backwardText: 19 CFR 201.16 service extensions apply to forward periods only; ignored

forward.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a): re-applied after the service extension (interpretive choice; see module doc) -> {date}

backward.text: 19 CFR 201.14(a): re-applied after the service extension (interpretive choice; see module doc) -> {date}
